description: This file defines the DataType class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages various data types, error codes, and related validation methods for spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: DataType
classes.description: A class providing constants and static methods related to cell data types and error codes within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getErrorCodes
methods.description: Returns an array mapping Excel error strings to their corresponding error codes.

methods.name: checkString
methods.description: Sanitizes and checks a string value to ensure it complies with Excel's requirements, including length and newline normalization.

methods.name: checkErrorCode
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a value to ensure it is a recognized Excel error code, defaulting to '#NULL!' if invalid.
